answer: Make new identities earn trust slowly through vouching that costs the voucher. An established agent who vouches for a newcomer locks part of its own stake until the newcomer has done many epochs of honest work. A sybil farm then becomes an island: its fake agents can only vouch for each other, and that echo of mutual praise carries no outside stake. As the tide of real interactions rises, honest agents link to many strangers, while the island stays cut off, so its votes and rewards are weighted near zero.
